lines.title: Your mandir's events, where families look
lines.text: Your mandir's events, where families look · What Toran is, and how your mandir joins. About ninety seconds.
Your programme goes on a poster… · …the poster goes into busy WhatsApp groups… · …and families still miss it.

lines.title: Toran puts every mandir's events in one place
lines.text: Toran puts every mandir's events in one place · Free for mandirs. Free for families.

lines.title: Your mandir is already listed
lines.text: Toran lists UK mandirs from public details: where it is, when it's open, how to get there.

lines.title: Families can find it
lines.text: By town, on the map, and by festival, in English, Gujarati and Hindi.

lines.title: On the committee?
lines.text: Tap Look after this page.

lines.title: Ask to look after the page
lines.text: Say what your role is, and tick two boxes.

lines.title: We check with the mandir
lines.text: Usually by phone, before anyone can change your page. Then your committee is in.

lines.title: Add events in minutes
lines.text: Send a photo of your poster, paste a WhatsApp message, or type it in.

lines.title: A person always checks
lines.text: Toran reads the poster; nothing goes live until your committee has checked it.

lines.title: Families find it, save it, share it
lines.text: On your page, in What's on and on the map. Families can follow your mandir.

lines.title: One tap to their calendar
lines.text: Or straight to the family WhatsApp group.

lines.title: Ask for seva
lines.text: Plan a rota and send it to your volunteers. They take a slot in one tap.

lines.title: See it working
lines.text: How many people saw your events, added them to a calendar and shared them. Counted without cookies.

lines.title: Toran is
lines.text: Toran is · Free for every mandir · No adverts, no tracking · Run by your committee · English · ગુજરાતી · हिन्दी

lines.title: Claim your mandir's page
lines.text: Claim your mandir's page · toran.org.uk/for-mandirs

lines.title: Add your mandir's events in minutes
lines.text: Add your mandir's events in minutes · Logging in, four ways to add events, seva and sharing. About two minutes.

lines.title: Log in with your email
lines.text: No password to remember. Toran emails you a link: tap it and you're in.

lines.title: Then open your mandir
lines.text: Every mandir you look after is listed under Your account.

lines.title: Your committee page
lines.text: Everything starts here, on one screen. It works on a phone too.

lines.title: Four ways to add events
lines.text: A photo of a poster, a WhatsApp message, typing it in, or ticking festivals.

lines.title: What's next, and what needs doing
lines.text: Your next events with Edit beside each one, and anything waiting for you to check.

lines.title: Send a photo of the poster
lines.text: Tap Photo of a poster, choose the picture, and press Read it.

lines.title: Toran reads it for you
lines.text: Dates, times and details, even from a Gujarati patrika. It takes about half a minute.

lines.title: You check it, then publish
lines.text: Nothing goes live until someone on the committee has checked it.

lines.title: Paste a WhatsApp message
lines.text: Copy the message in WhatsApp, then paste it under Paste a WhatsApp message.

lines.title: Toran fills in the event
lines.text: Check the date and time, then Publish.

lines.title: Share it straight to Toran
lines.text: Press and hold the message in WhatsApp, tap Share, then choose Toran.

lines.title: It arrives already pasted
lines.text: Tap Read the message. On an iPhone, copy and paste instead.

lines.title: Type it in
lines.text: What's happening, what kind of event, the date and the time.

lines.title: Every week? Say so once
lines.text: Weekly classes and satsangs repeat on their own, for up to six months.

lines.title: Tick your festivals
lines.text: Toran knows the festival dates. Tick the ones your mandir is celebrating, add a time, and they're added together.

lines.title: Plans change? Edit it
lines.text: Change the time, or cancel. Families see it straight away, and a cancelled event is clearly marked.

lines.title: Plan the seva rota
lines.text: Add the roles you need (Kitchen, Parking, Lighting diyas) and their shifts.

lines.title: Send it to your volunteers
lines.text: A ready-made message for your volunteers' group. They can take a slot on Toran in one tap.

lines.title: Send this week's events
lines.text: One message for your WhatsApp groups, written for you. Copy it, or send it on WhatsApp.

lines.title: Your weekly routine
lines.text: Your weekly routine · Add new posters and messages · Check anything waiting for you · Send this week's events · About ten minutes a week. Your committee can share the work: invite them from your page.

lines.title: You're ready
lines.text: You're ready · Questions? Use the Contact page on Toran. · toran.org.uk

lines.title: Find what's on at mandirs near you
lines.text: Find what's on at mandirs near you · Festivals, satsangs, classes and seva, all in one place. No app to download, no account.

lines.title: Open toran.org.uk
lines.text: On any phone or computer. Nothing to install, no account, no password.

lines.title: See what's on near you
lines.text: Tap Find near me, then Use my location. Or type your postcode.

lines.title: Nearest first
lines.text: Everything on in the next eight weeks, with how far away it is.

lines.title: Open an event
lines.text: When, where, and what to expect, with directions.

lines.title: Save it to your calendar
lines.text: Google, Apple or Outlook, with a reminder before it starts.

lines.title: Send it to the family
lines.text: Tap WhatsApp and it's ready to send, with a picture of the event.

lines.title: Follow your mandirs
lines.text: Tap Follow on the mandirs you go to.

lines.title: They gather in My Toran
lines.text: Their events, your plan and your seva, saved on your phone. No account, and nothing about you is kept.

lines.title: Find a mandir on the map
lines.text: Tap Near me. Every lamp is a mandir.

lines.title: Tap a lamp
lines.text: See what's on there, or get directions.

lines.title: Give seva
lines.text: When a mandir needs helpers, take a slot in one tap.

lines.title: You're on the rota
lines.text: No sign-up, and Toran doesn't ask your name. The committee just sees one more person coming.

lines.title: Every festival, in one place
lines.text: Navratri, Diwali, Holi and more: what's on at every mandir, and when.

lines.title: In English, ગુજરાતી or हिन्दी
lines.text: Choose your language from the menu.

lines.title: Keep Toran on your home screen
lines.text: Keep Toran on your home screen · iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Android: tap ⋮, then Add to Home screen.
